output.summary: On Helix HX-5000 release 7.4, an LACP EtherChannel can come up with fewer forwarding members than expected when the peer uses slow LACP timers. The bundle may appear operational, but one or more member links remain suspended after initialization or after a member flap.
output.symptoms:
Customers typically report that a 4-member LACP port-channel forms with only 2 active members, while the remaining links stay suspended for 30 to 90 seconds. Traffic forwards across the active members, but the suspended links do not join the aggregation immediately after a link returns.

Operational checks may show the partner as synchronized, which can make the issue appear intermittent or unrelated to LACP. After a member flap, `show interfaces port-channel` may display repeated collect/distribute mismatch messages, and the system log may report `%LACP-4-MISBUNDLE` events.
diagnosis_steps: Run `show lacp neighbor` and confirm the partner state is synchronized while the local bundle still has suspended members. This indicates LACP has formed adjacency, but member selection is not completing normally.

Run `show interfaces port-channel 10` and inspect the member status. In this issue, the port-channel stays up, but one or more member interfaces remain suspended or are missing from the forwarding set.

Check the interface counters and state for an affected member with `show interface ethernet <slot/port>`. Look for repeated bundle re-evaluation, suspend state, or collect/distribute mismatch indications after the link transitions up.
Review system logs with `show logging | include LACP` and confirm `%LACP-4-MISBUNDLE` appears shortly after a member flap or bundle reformation.

If available in your maintenance window, enable a short debug capture with `debug lacp events` and reproduce a single member flap. The issue is confirmed when the state machine logs show collect/distribute being entered before partner timer confirmation.
Verify the peer is using slow LACP timers by checking the adjacent switch configuration or LACP neighbor detail. This defect is specific to 7.4 when the peer advertises slow timers.
output.sample_output:
2026-03-14T02:13:07Z %LACP-4-MISBUNDLE: port-channel 10 member ethernet 1/1 suspended due to collect/distribute mismatch
2026-03-14T02:13:08Z %LACP-4-MISBUNDLE: port-channel 10 member ethernet 1/2 suspended due to collect/distribute mismatch

hx5000# show lacp neighbor
port-channel 10
  partner system-id     00:11:22:33:44:55
  partner key           10
  partner state         synchronized collecting distributing
  partner timeout       slow
  local state           synchronized collecting distributing

hx5000# show interfaces port-channel 10
port-channel10 is up, line protocol is up
  members: 4 configured, 2 forwarding, 2 suspended
  last state change: 2026-03-14T02:13:06Z
  mismatch reason: collect/distribute not yet confirmed on member ethernet 1/1
output.root_cause:
In release 7.4, the LACP state machine can transition a member into collect/distribute before the local system has verified the partner timeout bit when the peer is using slow LACP timers. That short ordering window produces a transient aggregation mismatch during bundle formation or when a member link flaps.

As a result, members that should join the EtherChannel are held in a suspended state until the control plane re-evaluates the bundle, which can take 30 to 90 seconds. The condition is specific to 7.4 and does not require a physical link fault on the affected interfaces.
workaround_steps: If the design permits, configure both ends of the EtherChannel to use fast LACP timers so the partner timeout is confirmed promptly during bundle formation.
If fast timers cannot be enabled on both sides, clear the affected EtherChannel after the member link has returned to force a fresh LACP negotiation and restore the forwarding set.
During maintenance on bundles that must remain on slow timers, avoid flapping individual member links; take down or restore the bundle in a controlled manner instead of cycling a single member.

After applying the operational workaround, verify that all configured members transition to forwarding with `show interfaces port-channel 10` and that no new `%LACP-4-MISBUNDLE` events appear in the log.
output.resolution: This defect is fixed in release 7.5. In 7.5 and later, member ports wait for partner timer confirmation before entering collect/distribute, preventing the transient misbundle condition seen on 7.4.
